data.name: Pick Playground
data.detailed_description:
Plan the pick. Rig it right. Make the lift.

Pick Playground is a 3D crane and rigging sandbox that lets you model lifts the way they are planned in the field. Choose a crane, set your boom length, angle, and slew, configure the rigging, shape your load, and see whether the pick holds up against real published manufacturer load charts. Built by a rigger with 18 years of professional experience, it treats the craft with the precision it deserves.

Rig it like you mean it

• Real rigging - bridle legs, sling spread, spreader bars, off-plumb picks, COG offsets, and custom leg lengths

• Live statics - watch sling tension, WLL, load swing, and dynamic load factors respond to every move

• Real load charts - judge each pick against published charts from real crane models

• Reeving that matters - parts of line, block weight, and line pull all factor into the gross load

Physics you can feel

Loads swing, tension builds, and an overloaded rig can fail. Shock-load a sling and it snaps. Overreach the chart and the crane tips. Every throttle input is your lever on sway and tension, just like the real thing.

Build something

Pick, connect, and assemble. Splice steel into longer sections, stand members upright, form cantilever towers, ballast outrigger bases, and bridge gaps. The sandbox is a construction kit as much as a crane sim. No gates, no gimmicks. Every crane, load, obstacle, and scene is yours to play with. Save your picks, share them, and come back to build more.

Solve real-world puzzles

Five zones, twenty-five levels, each a real rigging problem. Learn the fundamentals on the Drawing Board and work up to heavy multi-crane jobs, scored on how cleanly you plan and execute every pick.

data.short_description: Plan crane lifts like the pros. Pick your crane, configure the boom, rig the load, and judge every pick against real manufacturer load charts. A 3D rigging simulation sandbox from a rigger with 18 years in the field. Build it, rig it, lift it, land it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support (Intel HD 4000 / integrated graphics from 2012 or later)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on the OpenGL Compatibility renderer; no dedicated GPU required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU (GTX 1050 / integrated from 2018+)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 / Metal support
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal build; runs on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon GPU or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.3 support and up-to-date Mesa drivers
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs on the OpenGL Compatibility renderer; no dedicated GPU required.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU with current Mesa/proprietary drivers
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

data.legal_notice:
© 2026 Nate Young. All rights reserved.

All manufacturer names, crane models, load charts, and associated trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Pick Playground is an independent work and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any crane manufacturer. Load chart data is derived from publicly published manufacturer documentation and is provided for simulation purposes only.

Pick Playground is an entertainment and educational simulation. It is NOT a substitute for professional lift planning, engineering, or manufacturer load charts. Do not use this software to plan, validate, or execute real-world lifts. Always consult a qualified lift director, rigging engineer, and current manufacturer documentation.
